entities.name: Methyl ester saponification
observations: The encoded transformation replaces a methyl ester, C(=O)OCH3, with the corresponding carboxylic acid, C(=O)OH.
The scaffold carbonyl and heterocyclic functionality remain unchanged; no aldehyde or ketone redox transformation is encoded.

entities.name: NaOH MeOH H2O HCl
observations: Aqueous sodium hydroxide in methanol/water is a suitable saponification system, followed by hydrochloric acid acidification during workup.
Methanol functions as cosolvent and may also be present as the alcohol-derived byproduct.

entities.name: Ester-to-acid bond change
observations: The methoxy substituent of the ester is replaced by hydroxyl to form the free carboxylic acid.
